title: Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
description:
**Description**
Amazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid — accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real-time platforms: a high-throughput, event-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code — you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics — real-time and event-driven — of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.

Write high-quality, well-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews.
  
  

* Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade-offs clearly.

Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
  
  

* Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time.

Contribute to system-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures.
  
  
Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits.
  
  

* Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs.

Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth — without being asked.
  
  
Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system — incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services — tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time — globally, across all business lines and geographies.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Our products are trusted by institutional and retail investors, asset managers, and pension funds to benchmark performance, build investment portfolios, and manage risk.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Real Time Framework (RTF), our low-latency, cloud-native platform for calculating, managing and distributing FTSE Russell's real-time indices at global scale, spanning Equity, Fixed Income and Multi-Asset coverage. Build and version REST and gRPC APIs, including the public APIs and webhooks that

businesses integrate with.

balances consistent, and use Redis for caching and rate limiting.

Integrate with banks, payment providers, blockchain networks and KYC vendors,

handling timeouts, retries and their webhooks safely.

Write safe concurrent Go code, with context timeouts and proper locking, and

without race conditions or goroutine leaks.

Build money movement flows: pay-ins, single and bulk payouts, currency conversion

with quotes, fees, refunds and returned payments.

Build business payment workflows such as bulk supplier payouts, approval chains,

scheduled payments and payment reports.

Record every movement in a double-entry ledger, so balances always reconcile with

banks, partners and blockchains.

Make every money-moving API idempotent, so retries and duplicate requests never

move money twice.

Full-Stack Software Engineer

Page 2 of 5
Handle money with exact decimal or integer minor-unit arithmetic, never floating

point, across currencies and stablecoin token decimals.

Track every transaction through its full lifecycle (pending, processing, settled, failed,

returned) and build reconciliation for it.

Build the Fin dashboard and hosted checkout in Next.js, React and TypeScript:

payments, payouts, wallets, virtual accounts, onboarding and reports.

Build complex B2B screens: role-based access, maker-checker approvals, large

Build KYB and KYC onboarding flows with document uploads, verification states and

resubmissions.

Turn Figma designs into accessible, responsive and reusable components.

Write unit, integration and end-to-end tests across Go and TypeScript code, covering

every money-moving path.

Ship through CI/CD with feature flags, safe database migrations and gradual rollouts.

Add logs, metrics and traces to what you build (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus,

Grafana, Sentry), and own its alerts.

Build security in: authentication and authorization, input validation, secrets

management, OWASP Top 10 protection, and safe handling of personal and bank data.

Join an on-call rotation for the services you own, and lead fixes and root-cause

Work with product, design, QA and compliance to turn financial and regulatory rules

into working software.

Review code, share knowledge and help raise engineering standards.

Use AI coding assistants responsibly for understanding code, implementation,

refactoring and tests, while owning quality, security and correctness.

5+ years of professional software development, building and running production web

applications across frontend and backend.

2+ years building payments products, with hands-on work on money movement such

Experience at a fintech, bank, financial institution or payments company, or on

Production experience with Go (Golang) for backend services. Strong backend

considered.

Strong production experience with React, TypeScript and Next.js.

Experience designing and running microservices: REST and gRPC APIs, message

queues and service-to-service communication.

Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including transactions, indexing and migrations.

A track record of owning features end to end, including how they behave in

production.

Strong written and spoken English.

Go: goroutines, channels, context, error handling, interfaces, generics and net/http.

API design: REST, gRPC and protobuf, OpenAPI, versioning, pagination, and signed

webhooks with retries.

Event-driven systems: Kafka, NATS or RabbitMQ, the outbox pattern, idempotent

consumers and eventual consistency.

Data: PostgreSQL (transactions, isolation levels, locking, indexes, migrations) and

Redis.

Security: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS between services, HMAC request signing and

secrets management.

**Frontend (Next.js)**

TypeScript, React (hooks, state, performance) and Next.js (App Router, Server and

Client Components, SSR and ISR, caching and revalidation).

Data fetching and state with TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit or Zustand, forms with

Docker, Kubernetes and a major cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure).

CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), feature flags and safe database migrations.

Observability with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana and Sentry or similar.

Testing: Go’s testing package, testify and the race detector; Jest or Vitest with React

Testing Library; Playwright for end-to-end tests; Testcontainers for integration tests.

AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), used with careful review.

Stablecoin or blockchain experience: wallets, on-chain transfers, confirmations and

Experience with cross-border payments, remittances, currency exchange or treasury

systems.

Integrations with payment rails or networks, such as ACH, SEPA, SWIFT, Faster

Payments, UPI, mobile money or card networks.

Designing ledgers and reconciliation systems.

Building compliance-related systems: KYC/KYB, AML and sanctions screening, and

Experience in regulated environments, such as PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

GraphQL, monorepos (e.g., Turborepo, Nx) or micro-frontends.

Experience with markets Fin serves, such as South and Southeast Asia, the Middle

title: Systems Engineer
description:

title: Sr. Systems Engineer (Linux)
description:

Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer. Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play. We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond. Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As Senior Linux Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, automation, standardization, and lifecycle management of Williams-Sonoma's Linux estate. You will help improve platform reliability, security, scalability, and operational efficiency across on-premises and cloud-hosted environments.
  
  
This role is ideal for a hands-on infrastructure engineer with strong Linux fundamentals, growing automation capabilities, and sound operational judgment. You will partner closely with senior engineers, architects, and support teams to deliver reliable platform services, improve day-to-day operations, and contribute to the continued evolution of Linux platform engineering.
  
  
**Impact of the Role**

* Improve platform reliability, security, scalability, and operational efficiency across enterprise Linux environments.
* Drive automation and infrastructure-as-code practices across provisioning, configuration, patching, compliance, and operational workflows.
* Support the modernization and evolution of Linux platform engineering.
* Enhance operational readiness, incident response effectiveness, and platform observability.
* Support enterprise infrastructure powering large-scale digital commerce and business operations.

* Define, implement, and maintain enterprise standards for Linux platforms, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux and related tooling.

* Partner with architects and peer engineering teams to evaluate new technologies, run proof-of-concept initiatives, and contribute to the Linux platform roadmap.
* Gather technical and business requirements and translate them into scalable infrastructure designs and implementation plans.
* Collaborate closely with production support and Level 2 operations teams to improve runbooks, handoffs, operational readiness, and incident response effectiveness.
* Create and maintain high-quality engineering documentation, including standards, build guides, implementation records, and operational procedures.
* Provide data-driven recommendations on platform health, capacity, risk, and modernization opportunities.

* 7+ years leading technical teams that solve complex problems and provide detailed technical and business analysis.

* Familiarity with Active Directory integration for Linux, including service principals, Kerberos, and keytab-based authentication, is a plus.

* Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.
* Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. title: BC Sector O And G-Cognite-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Cognite Solution Architect – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level - 15+**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Solution Architect to design industrial data solutions for upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations. You will define how operational, enterprise and engineering information is integrated, modelled and contextualized in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), and how applications and analytical solutions consume that information. You will own solution architecture decisions, establish reusable implementation patterns and resolve complex technical issues across source systems, data models, access controls and consuming applications.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Architecture and integration**

* Translate operational use cases into data requirements, integration designs and application-consumption patterns.
* Define how CDF fits within historian, enterprise application, engineering information and cloud architectures.
* Select source-appropriate extractors, APIs and processing patterns, considering latency, throughput, connectivity and source-system load.
* Define historical loading, incremental extraction, reconciliation and recovery approaches, including late records, corrections and supported deletions.
* Establish requirements for service identities, access capabilities, environment separation, monitoring and operational support.

**Industrial information modelling**

* Design CDF models using spaces, containers, views and instances; select direct relations or edges according to relationship semantics and query requirements.
* Reuse and extend Cognite’s Core Data Model where suitable, introducing custom domain concepts where required.
* Define stable identifiers, source crosswalks and conflict-resolution rules, including repeated tag names across sites and systems.
* Represent physical equipment, functional locations and installation history separately where required.
* Establish schema versioning, migration and consumer-compatibility requirements while preserving lineage, timestamps, units, quality indicators and relationship provenance.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas semantics**

* Design relationships connecting equipment and assets with time series, maintenance records, documents and engineering diagrams.
* Define matching rules, confidence thresholds, exception handling and domain review for ambiguous associations; assess coverage and match accuracy separately.
* For upstream applications, model fields, wells, wellbores, production facilities, equipment, well tests and interventions, preserving distinctions between measured, calculated and allocated production.
* For downstream applications, model sites, process units, functional locations, equipment, laboratory results and maintenance activities, accounting for replacement, revisions and measurement timing.
* Validate that contextualized information supports the intended engineering workflow.
* Application enablement and technical assurance
* Define consumer data contracts covering entities, relationships, fields, freshness, permissions and query-performance expectations.
* Validate designs against representative Cognite applications, custom applications, and analytical or AI workflows.
* Develop critical prototypes and reference implementations using Python, SQL, Cognite SDKs and APIs.
* Establish deployment and environment-promotion practices using version control, automated validation and Cognite Toolkit.
* Review architecture changes, migration plans, integration code and performance bottlenecks; resolve cross-system design conflicts and mentor data engineering leads.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Demonstrated personal architectural contribution to a production Cognite Data Fusion implementation.
* Strong knowledge of CDF data modelling, transformations, contextualization and access controls.
* Substantial industrial data integration experience spanning representative operational, enterprise and engineering sources.
* Strong Python and SQL skills with practical Cognite SDK and REST API experience.
* Experience defining identity strategies, model evolution, deployment patterns and production support requirements.
* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, identity providers, network boundaries and CI/CD.
* Strong Oil & Gas implementation experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain, with ability to adapt relevant concepts to the other.

**Good to Have**

* Cognite implementation experience across multiple assets or sites.
* Experience spanning both upstream and downstream.
* Familiarity with historians, maintenance systems, laboratory systems, engineering repositories or well-data services.
* Experience with diagram contextualization, 3D associations and industrial knowledge graphs.
* Experience enabling Cognite applications or AI workflows using contextualized data.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on architect who can defend consequential production Cognite decisions involving identity resolution, data-model design, access boundaries, recovery, schema migration and application compatibility, and demonstrate which patterns can be reused across sites and which require adaptation.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation for Graphics Systems
description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems' quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive.
  
  
NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team’s transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release.
* Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end.
* Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done.
* Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model.
* Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes.

**What We Need To See**

* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks.
* Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track.
* 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering.
* High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team’s traditional capacity.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes.
* Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL.
* Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software.

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you.

**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include**
:
  
  
**Scientific formulation and advanced modelling**

* Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or prescriptive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
* Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
* Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
* Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
* Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
* Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
* Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.

**Upstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for production forecasting, well surveillance, artificial-lift performance, drilling analytics, and production-system optimization.
* Separate the effects of reservoir behaviour, operating constraints, equipment condition, interventions, formation changes, and operating practices when interpreting performance.
* Collaborate with reservoir engineers and geoscientists on property prediction, uncertainty analysis, and simulation-assisted modelling.
* Determine whether models can transfer between wells or fields and define the data, recalibration, adaptation, and validation required.

**Downstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for product-quality prediction, yield modelling, equipment degradation, blending, and process or energy optimization.
* Account for feedstock composition, throughput, catalyst age, equipment condition, process configuration, and control-system behaviour.
* Combine data-driven methods with engineering relationships, process simulations, and mass and energy balances.
* Connect predictive models with operating, planning, blending, or optimization workflows within defined physical and operational constraints, validating across feedstock changes, campaigns, grades, and configurations.

**Model assurance and generalization**

* Establish standards for baselining, benchmarking, feature-ablation studies, calibration, sensitivity analysis, robustness, and out-of-distribution evaluation.
* Challenge apparent improvements caused by leakage, weak baselines, inappropriate metrics, selective testing, or inadequate engineering interpretation.
* Distinguish models that reproduce historical associations from models capable of evaluating proposed operating changes.
* Define applicability limits, uncertainty treatment, monitoring requirements, fallback behaviour, and recalibration or retraining criteria.
* Assess predictive performance separately from recommendation feasibility and quality, and establish adaptation and validation strategies across assets, sites, configurations, and operating regimes.

**Technical leadership and scalable delivery**

* Remain hands-on in experiments, model development, prototyping, and troubleshooting.
* Resolve failures across data preparation, measurement quality, engineering assumptions, model formulation, software implementation, and production behaviour.
* Develop reusable modelling components, adaptation strategies, technical standards, and reference implementations; design reproducible experiments whose conclusions can be reviewed and defended.
* Evaluate emerging techniques through controlled comparisons with established methods and review production implementations for consistency with the intended scientific approach.
* Conduct scientific reviews, challenge modelling decisions, mentor Lead Data Scientists, and collaborate with engineering, data, ML engineering, and product teams to integrate validated models into operational workflows.

* A degree in a relevant engineering, scientific, or quantitative discipline.
* Substantial hands-on experience developing and deploying Oil & Gas analytical solutions.
* Deep expertise in at least one upstream or downstream area, with working knowledge across both segments.
* Advanced expertise in at least one relevant applied modelling specialization.
* Strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, mathematical modelling, industrial time series, scientific computing, experimental design, and uncertainty assessment.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, including scientific prototyping, implementation of critical modelling components, and review of production code.
* Experience integrating engineering knowledge into model formulation and validation, together with reproducible experimentation, production ML, model generalization, and deployment across varied operating conditions.
* Evidence of personally resolving a difficult methodological problem and establishing an approach adopted by others.
* Experience conducting technical reviews and guiding multidisciplinary data science teams.
* Ability to defend technical decisions using quantitative evidence and clearly communicate assumptions, trade-offs, limitations, and operational implications.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience across both upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A master’s degree, PhD, or relevant applied research experience.
* Expertise in system identification, robust optimization, physics-informed learning, simulation surrogates, or uncertainty propagation.
* Experience with distributed scientific computing, scalable inference, cloud ML platforms, and production MLOps.
* Experience combining validated numerical models with knowledge graphs, specialized language models, or agentic decision-support workflows.
* Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or reusable technical assets demonstrating applied scientific contribution.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact modelling and decision-support challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations.
* A role with hands-on technical authority, scientific leadership, and the opportunity to establish reusable methods and standards for multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data science, ML engineering, product, and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem, and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

****Job Description:****
The Data Engineer within the Husky DST Data Team will play a key role in supporting and advancing Husky’s enterprise-wide Business Intelligence and Data Management ecosystem. Working as part of the global DST organization, this role is responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, and scalability of the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and associated data pipelines across both on‑premises and Azure cloud environments.
  
  
The Data Engineer will proactively monitor and optimize back-end data load processes, contribute to the design, development, and deployment of data integration and transformation solutions, and ensure adherence to data governance and development lifecycle standards. In addition, this role will support Data Management initiatives aimed at meeting Husky’s evolving information needs, including data quality, metadata, and master data management activities.
  
  
The position will also lead infrastructure capacity assessments, performance tuning efforts, and recommendations for architectural improvements to ensure the long-term efficiency and sustainability of Husky’s data platforms.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities & Key Success Metrics**
:**

* Execute end‑to‑end Enterprise Business Intelligence and Data Engineering initiatives, including requirement analysis, BI specification development, data modeling, solution design, deployment, and post‑production support.
* Serve as a technical consultant and facilitator between cross‑functional teams, ensuring effective communication and alignment among business units, project teams, and technical stakeholders.
* Perform root‑cause analysis and drive timely resolution of production issues, ensuring minimal disruption to BI processes and data platforms.
* Support both pre‑production and production data infrastructure environments, ensuring stability, performance, and adherence to operational standards.
* Participate in planning, preparation, and execution of periodic software releases, ensuring smooth deployment of enhancements, patches, and new features.
* Collaborate closely with project teams, business stakeholders, and leadership, translating business needs into scalable and maintainable data solutions.
* Coordinate with internal and external partners, such as vendors, integration teams, and cloud service providers, to ensure seamless project delivery and system operations.
* Conduct detailed requirements analysis and documentation, ensuring clarity, completeness, and alignment with enterprise architecture guidelines.
* Execute assigned project tasks and deliverables, contributing to successful completion of work packages within scope, timeline, and quality expectations.
* Perform advanced data analysis, data profiling, and validation to support data modeling, quality assessments, and integration design.
* Support the program manager in planning, coordination, and delivery of the overall Enterprise Business Intelligence program, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise quality standards, including coding best practices, documentation, testing, and data governance policies.
* Contribute to Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives, supporting data quality, standardization, and stewardship processes across the organization.

****Qualifications:****
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience working in data engineering, business intelligence, or analytics-focused roles within complex enterprise environments.
* Proven experience delivering and supporting Business Intelligence, Data Warehouse, and Data Integration solutions at scale.
* Experience working in global or multinational environments is an asset.
* Understanding of manufacturing and sales business processes is considered beneficial.

****Technical Skills****

* Strong hands-on experience with ETL/ELT development involving medium to high complexity integration pipelines, ensuring high availability, data quality, and reliability in production environments.
* Proficient with a broad range of Microsoft data and analytics technologies, including:

+ Databases & Platforms: SQL Server 2019/2022
+ Data Integration: SSIS, Azure Data Factory (ADF)
+ Analytics & Modeling: SSAS, Power BI
+ Cloud: Azure Synapse, Azure Data Lake, and related Azure data engineering services
+ Programming & Scripting: T‑SQL, PowerShell, VBA, VBScript

* Familiarity with Data Warehouse Automation tools such as dbt (Data Build Tool) is a strong advantage.
* Familiarity with Data Replication tools such as FiveTran is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of server operational environments, particularly Windows Server 2019/2022.
* Experience implementing and supporting DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and version control.

****Analytical & Problem‑Solving Capabilities****

* Demonstrated expertise in data analysis, data profiling, and root‑cause investigation across complex datasets and pipelines.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities with the capacity to diagnose application, data quality, and system performance issues.
* Ability to monitor, evaluate, and interpret ETL results, collaborating closely with operations and delivery teams to drive improvements in data quality and platform stability.

****Soft Skills & Collaboration****

* Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non‑technical audiences.
* Strong facilitation skills, capable of moderating meetings, workshops, and design sessions to support effective decision‑making.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams, internal partners, and external vendors.

****Language Requirements****

* Fluency in English is required.
* German and French language skills are considered an asset.
